# Old World

Old World uses a relaxed, low-contrast color palette described for comfortable, extended reading and writing. Its typography pairs the Karla and Geist Mono fonts.

![Old World screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/double-tilde/old-world-obsidian/HEAD/images/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Old World"
    author: "double-tilde"
    repo:   "double-tilde/old-world-obsidian"
    slug:   "old-world"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/old-world"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/double-tilde/old-world-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/double-tilde/old-world-obsidian/HEAD/images/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a relaxed, low-contrast color palette crafted for comfortable, extended reading and writing. Use Karla and Geist Mono fonts for a clean, balanced look."
}
```
